snippet.title: Edentopia Demo | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Edentopia demo out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356950/Edentopia/

An open-world sandbox RPG where every weapon transforms how you fight. Hunt monsters, craft gear from their materials, and shape your build through stats, enchantment, spells, and pets. Explore freely, challenge bosses at your own pace, and carve your own path through a world of magic and discovery.
